evidence.text: 2. Then, the contract calculates the amount after the split (including the bonus), which is calculated as: _splitAmount = _amount + calculate_sm_nft_bonus(_amount).
3. The remaining amount of the original locked position is newLocked.amount - _splitAmount. Note that newLocked.amount is the total amount of the original locked position (including the bonus).

The problem is that the total amount of the original locked position (ie newLocked.amount) already includes the bonus. When splitting, the split part calculates the bonus again, resulting in repeated calculation of the bonus.

links.reported_relation: Because the original locked amount already includes the bonus, recalculating the bonus on the split part repeats the bonus calculation instead of splitting proportionally.
The split amount is computed as _amount plus a freshly calculated bonus rather than as a proportional share of the original amount.
